entities.name: Elizah
entities.description: A brutal combatant who views killing as maintenance work, capable of casual animalistic violence while maintaining a bizarrely cheerful demeanor.
entities.quote: The Apex behind him is missing its ribcage in the functional sense — the chest cavity has been introduced to the outside world and found the introduction permanent.

entities.name: Rowan
entities.description: A powerhouse fighter characterized by extreme durability and the use of a heavy chain weapon imbued with blue flame.
entities.quote: The links wrap the hybrid's arm mid-charge with the speed of something that has been thrown correctly, and Rowan pulls. The physics are simple: the hybrid's momentum is now Rowan's to direct.

entities.name: David
entities.description: A highly agile and theatrical combatant who utilizes portals to manipulate the position of his dagger, treating battle as a dance.
entities.quote: He opens a portal at chest height in front of him. Steps backward into it. Comes out of a portal directly behind his own attacker. The dagger is already moving.

entities.name: Zayn
entities.description: A powerhouse who utilizes precise red lightning as a weapon, capable of both surgical strikes and devastating, boiling levels of rage.
entities.quote: His hand snaps forward and the red lightning threads — not the explosive discharge of full combat mode, the precise surgical expression of someone using current as a scalpel.
